searchText: I was reading the privacy roadmap and have a simple question: can I say that Plasma Fold + Kohaku = Zcash on Ethereum? (I also want to note that a significant limitation of Zcash is that it only supports one single token and there hasn't been too much progress on multi-token... but it seems to be obvious for Ethereum to go multi-token)

excerpts.content:
I was reading the privacy roadmap and have a simple question: can I say that Plasma Fold + Kohaku = Zcash on Ethereum?

(I also want to note that a significant limitation of Zcash is that it only supports one single token and there hasn't been too much progress on multi-token... but it seems to be obvious for Ethereum to go multi-token)
